plotted_MP: Mp_Liu_Kim1983 = (2/3)*(log10(P0[m3])+1.4563), identical to Liu equation 2 after unit conversion.
other_28GPa_reference: Retained in explicitly named Mpo28 columns; not used as the MP axis in the Liu comparison.
C_status: The Liu MP axis uses the exact published definition. Current Mw retains C=9.05. There is no extra C or 28-to-36-GPa correction to apply to the plotted MP.

literature.result: Reports no clear systematic hypocentral-depth trend in residuals MP minus the published quadratic ML relation, across four datasets.
literature.scope: Three newly analyzed regional datasets plus the existing regional potency catalog. The regional-catalog subset in S7 is restricted to ML>3 and within-bin outliers greater than 0.5 MP are removed. This is not proof of zero depth effects in every region.
literature.access: Supplied full main paper and supplement inspected; S7 rendered and viewed.

literature.result: Mw=0.96+0.84 ML-0.0055(hc-25), with centroid depth hc in km; reported depth-coefficient uncertainty 0.0015 and residual standard deviation 0.31.
literature.scope: Larger historical/instrumental New Zealand earthquakes, roughly M5 and above and extending to much greater depths. Same sign as the Korean trend, but not a transferable Korean calibration.
literature.access: Primary full-text publisher PDF and equation inspected.

literature.title: A Depth-Dependent Local Magnitude Scale for New Zealand Earthquakes Consistent with Moment Magnitude
literature.result: NZ20 adds a hypocentral-depth explanatory variable to ML attenuation to improve consistency with Mw over the New Zealand depth range.
literature.scope: Regional calibration with heterogeneous crustal/subduction depths; does not validate its depth coefficients for Korean crustal earthquakes.
literature.access: Primary publisher abstract verified through search; full text not retrieved.

literature.title: Discussion of local magnitude scale for deep earthquakes in Taiwan
literature.result: Hypocentral-distance-only ML attenuation leaves depth-dependent residuals. Including log depth produces recalibrated ML with no remaining depth trend and approximately one-to-one Mw scaling; reported scatter 0.16.
literature.scope: 649 events, Mw 3.0-6.6, depths 35-313 km; demonstrates calibration dependence, not a numerical correction for Korea.

literature.result: Station-ML minus event-ML residuals become negative for deeper-than-10-km, Foreland-dominated data; authors emphasize regional/path dependence.
literature.scope: Related caution: station/event ML residuals are NOT direct Mw-ML or Mp-ML residuals. Do not present this as direct evidence for the question.
literature.access: Primary institutional full-text PDF inspected, discussion and Figure 15.

interpretation: A matched MP magnitude zero point rules out a reference-rigidity convention mismatch. It does not validate source amplitudes or ML calibration. P/S source inference, velocity/path/site corrections, amplitude conventions and selected event populations differ. A pooled cross-region curve does not establish identical regional offsets.
prior_omission: The prior depth discussion did not highlight Liu main-text p.8 and Figure S7. These directly relevant results have now been added to the report reading notes and discussion.
